veranderings.voor: Die danser se eie voete laat hulle skud.
veranderings.na: Die danser se eie voete laat die kokonratels skud.
veranderings.rede: 'hulle' could refer to the dancers, the cocoons or the pebbles; naming the rattles makes the reference clear without changing the meaning.

vlae.teks: Party dansers in Suid-Afrika bind kokonratels om hulle enkels vas. Dit is lang rye gedroogde kokonne met sand of klippies binne.
vlae.rede: The protected entry for 'kokonratels' says the compound is always introduced in full ('ratels van gedroogde kokonne') before it is used, but here the heading and first sentence use the compound before the description; this is an order-of-introduction question for the writer, not a language change.
